name: Spuskaemiy apparat
about: Spuskaemiy apparat (1964-016D, NII88), launched 1964 Apr  2. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Venus. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Venus on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.676 au and aphelion 1.001 au against GCAT's 0.652 and 1.001
